about: A person's verdict on a picture of the gallery, and nobody else's. A picture the engine draws can be wrong in a way no counter sees. To give a verdict, add an entry under 'verdicts' with the picture's name (its file name without .png): {"who": "your name", "verdict": "right" | "wrong" | "uncertain", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "what you saw"}. The next build prints it under the picture. A model's opinion does not belong in this file.
